blocks.text: Hypothesis testing is a method used to make decisions using data. It checks whether an assumption is true or false. This method is widely used in research and analysis. Hypothesis testing follows a clear process that helps accept or reject assumptions. Data is collected and analyzed carefully. This method reduces guesswork as it supports evidence-based decisions.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing checks assumptions using data. It helps decide whether a claim is true. This method is used in research and experiments. It reduces guesswork. Results depend on proper testing.
